content.question: Which mathematical procedure does PCA rely on?
options: Calculating pairwise distances between points and taking a majority vote.
Calculating eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix of the input data.
Minimizing the divergence between t-distributions of pairwise similarities.
Estimating a separate covariance matrix for each class.
content.answer: Calculating eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix of the input data.
